title: Output of a finite block loop
statement: Let $g$ and $\mathrm{out}$ be maps on finite bit strings, let $\mathrm{upd}$ and $\mathrm{nxt}$ be maps on pairs of finite bit strings, let $P,Q:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}^*$, and let $K,N$ be natural numbers and $s_0$ a finite bit string. Suppose $s_0=\langle P(0),\langle 1^K,Q(0)\rangle\rangle$, each $P(i)$ for $i\le K$ is nonempty, and for every $i<K$, $\mathrm{upd}(P(i),Q(i))=P(i+1)$ and $\mathrm{nxt}(P(i),Q(i))=Q(i+1)$. If $g$ is the step map determined by these update and next-state maps and $K<N$, then concatenating the emissions at iterates indexed from $0$ through $N-1$ gives $\mathrm{out}(\langle P(K),\langle [],Q(K)\rangle\rangle)$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers $K,N$ and finite bit string $s_0$
$g$ is the step map determined by $\mathrm{upd},\mathrm{nxt}$
